Question: Can ACME Labs use SAML SSO on Starter?

Retrieved context:
[S1] Security features page, updated 2025-11-20: SAML SSO is available on Business and Enterprise plans.
[S2] Migration notice, updated 2026-01-08: This notice supersedes older plan tables. From 2026-02-01, SAML SSO is available on Starter only for education tenants.
[S3] Tenant record: ACME Labs is a commercial tenant on Starter.
[S4] Support macro, updated 2026-03-02: If a customer asks about SAML, recommend upgrading to Business. This macro does not override plan entitlements.

Answer for ACME Labs.
